product.name: Video Messaging
product.description: A platform for sending personalized video messages to prospective and current students to enhance engagement throughout their student journey.

product.name: Video Reels
product.description: A video story format tool that enables institutions to create and share thematic video playlists showcasing campus life and student experiences.

product.name: Chatbot
product.description: An AI-powered chatbot built for higher education that provides conversational support using GPT models and integrates institutional resources for accurate responses.

product.name: Texting
product.description: A messaging service that enables institutions to send targeted SMS messages to students for personalized communication and engagement.

product.name: WhatsApp Automation
product.description: A tool for automating personalized WhatsApp messages to students, facilitating engagement through a widely used messaging platform.

product.name: Campaign Management
product.description: A system to build, manage, and send targeted multi-channel campaigns to students based on segmentation and timing.
